arguments:
set -u
sha256sum -c build/small-divisor-native/paired-captures/pre-capture.sha256 > build/small-divisor-native/paired-captures/source-check-before-repeat.log || exit 74
cat /proc/pressure/io > build/small-divisor-native/paired-captures/repeat-attempt2-io-before.txt
awk '/^full / {split($2,a,"="); split($3,b,"="); exit !(a[2] < 1 && b[2] < 1)}' build/small-divisor-native/paired-captures/repeat-attempt2-io-before.txt || exit 75
date -u +%FT%TZ > build/small-divisor-native/paired-captures/repeat-start.utc
nice -n 10 /home/rich/bin/vfp9-probe tests/fixtures/vfp9-numeric-division-context/small-divisor-grid.prg --result build/small-divisor-native/grid-results.txt > build/small-divisor-native/paired-captures/repeat.out 2> build/small-divisor-native/paired-captures/repeat.stderr
task_probe_rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$task_probe_rc" > build/small-divisor-native/paired-captures/repeat.status
if [ "$task_probe_rc" -ne 0 ]; then exit "$task_probe_rc"; fi
cp build/small-divisor-native/grid-results.txt build/small-divisor-native/paired-captures/repeat-results.txt
cat /proc/pressure/io > build/small-divisor-native/paired-captures/repeat-io-after.txt
date -u +%FT%TZ > build/small-divisor-native/paired-captures/repeat-end.utc
sha256sum -c build/small-divisor-native/paired-captures/pre-capture.sha256 > build/small-divisor-native/paired-captures/source-check-after-repeat.log || exit 74
wc -c build/small-divisor-native/paired-captures/first-results.txt build/small-divisor-native/paired-captures/repeat-results.txt
cat build/small-divisor-native/paired-captures/first.status build/small-divisor-native/paired-captures/repeat.status
